parameters.name: BucketAcl
parameters.description: Bucket permission type: private (default). public-read-write: Allows public read and write access. public-read: Allows public read access.

parameters.name: BucketName
parameters.description: Bucket name. Must be 3 to 50 characters long. Use only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (-). Cannot start or end with a hyphen.

parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: Comment. Up to 128 characters, including letters, digits, Chinese characters, and emojis.

parameters.name: DispatchScope
parameters.description:
Scheduling scope. Valid values:

- domestic (within China)

- outside China

> You must specify this parameter when creating a global bucket.

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: Edge zone ID. If not specified, the global default edge zone is used.

parameters.name: LogicalBucketType
parameters.description: The logical type of the bucket. Valid values: sink: A sink bucket on a specified node. standard: A standard global bucket. This is the default value.
